name: Dhol
notes:
Not anybody's dog and never was. A pack shadows whichever string of animals is going the right way, keeping a field's distance and taking what falls out of the back of it -- the lame, the old, the afterbirth. The drovers do not feed them, do not drive them off, and would notice at once if they were not there, because a pack that has stopped following is a pack that has found something better to follow.

They whistle rather than bark. A drover a mile ahead knows from the pitch whether the pack is moving or holding, which is a thing nobody taught either side.
journal_prompt: Rust-red, low, and forty paces off the track since the ford. It has not once looked back to check you are still coming, and it has not once let the distance change.
